title: First Run
summary: Borrow my car. Collect sealed cargo at Bay Supply. Wait for a quiet handover for a $150 bonus, or force a fast pickup and face the police. Bring it home clean.

car.text: Get a car. Mara's is outside the safehouse.

pickup.text: Drive to {place} ({distance} m), stop in the bay, then K to hand over — or B for a fast pickup.

load.text: Loading… keep the car still in the bay ({loaded}s).

escape.text: Lose the police. Break line of sight and stay hidden.

deliver.text: Deliver to {place} ({distance} m). Stop in the bay and press K.
